db9e998d797dedc0.job_title: Senior Project / Cost Controls Engineer (Commercial/ Internal)
db9e998d797dedc0.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Senior Project / Cost Controls Engineer (Commercial/ Internal) to join its team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, covering both Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires over 10 years of experience and focuses on providing comprehensive project controls support across various financial and operational aspects of projects. Role Overview and Responsibilities The Senior Project / Cost Controls Engineer will manage cost, schedule, risk, revenue, margin, cash flow, and change management. The position involves establishing reliable project baselines, converting operational data into accurate forecasts and P&L insights, and supporting timely risk management decisions throughout the project lifecycle. This role operates with a high degree of independence while ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, internal governance, and established project controls processes. Develop and maintain project budgets, cost breakdown structures, and Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), aligning them with scope, schedule, procurement strategy, resource plans, and contractual deliverables. Prepare monthly forecasts including estimate to complete (ETC), estimate at completion (EAC), revenue, gross profit, margin, cash flow, and headcount assumptions, explaining material variances. Track commitments, actual costs, accruals, and forecast costs, identifying unfavorable trends and recommending corrective actions. Apply Earned Value Management (EVM) principles and other performance-measurement techniques to evaluate cost and schedule performance. Support appropriate revenue recognition methods, prepare and validate accruals, and ensure accurate monthly reporting. Interpret contractual and subcontract terms affecting revenue, margin, billing, cash collection, and risk allocation, escalating material commercial exposure. Identify, quantify, document, and track client and internal changes, ensuring reflection in project forecasts, risk registers, budgets, and schedules. Facilitate identification and assessment of project risks and opportunities, maintaining risk registers and monitoring contingency. Interpret payment terms, support accurate invoicing, forecast collections, and monitor accounts receivable and unbilled balances. Interpret project schedules, progress data, critical milestones, and resource requirements, assessing cost and commercial impact of schedule movement. Prepare concise dashboards and management reports covering cost, schedule, revenue, margin, cash, risks, opportunities, and changes. Partner with Project Directors, Project Managers, technical leads, Finance, Commercial, Contracts, and Procurement teams. Reconcile revenue, gross profit, final costs, commitments, and changes during project closeout. Required Skills and Qualifications Candidates must possess a strong foundation in project controls and financial acumen, coupled with analytical and communication abilities. Technical Project Controls: Strong knowledge of cost control, forecasting, budgeting, EVM, change control, risk management, cash flow, and performance reporting. Financial and Commercial Acumen: Ability to understand project P&L, revenue recognition, margin drivers, accruals, working capital, contract terms, and financial consequences of project decisions. Data and Systems: Advanced Microsoft Excel capability and practical experience producing clear Power BI dashboards. Working knowledge of project controls, scheduling, ERP, and cost-management systems is preferred. Analytical Thinking: Ability to interpret complex data, challenge assumptions, identify trends and root causes, and translate analysis into clear actions. Accuracy and Governance: Strong attention to detail, disciplined documentation, and commitment to reliable, auditable, and timely reporting. Communication and Influence: Clear written and verbal communication, with the confidence to explain financial and project-control issues to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Desired Attributes Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across project, technical, commercial, finance, and leadership teams while maintaining constructive challenge and accountability. Prioritization and Adaptability: Ability to manage competing deadlines, respond to changing project conditions, and maintain reporting quality in a demanding environment. Problem-Solving: Practical approach to resolving complex project-controls issues, closing data gaps, and developing proportionate recovery or mitigation actions. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities extending to projects in Jeddah. The role involves close collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders, requiring a proactive and independent approach to project controls.

db9816abc62e8290.description: About the Role Ma’aden is seeking a Principal Specialist, Data Modeling & Arch (Operational Technology) . This full-time role is responsible for establishing the foundational data modeling and architecture for Operational Technology (OT) and industrial data across various plants, sites, and operational systems. Align data from historians, SCADA/DCS, condition monitoring, maintenance, reliability, and production systems with enterprise data products. Define integration rules for tag mapping, unit standardization, reference data, semantic consistency, and cross-site normalization. Support cross-domain analytics by ensuring OT data is usable for insights related to reliability, production performance, safety, sustainability, and cost. Accelerating Data Initiatives This role will accelerate site onboarding, tag normalization, unit standardization, and data model reuse through the development and application of practical reference patterns. The objective is to streamline data processes and enhance efficiency across operational technology environments. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

db2ecff3a8de55d4.description: About Telnyx Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications. We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team. Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers. The Role We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Riyadh — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless. This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale. You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall. The Pod Model Enterprise AE — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account. Forward Deployed Engineer — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload. We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu. What You'll Do Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models like Jais, ALLaM, or other Arabic-language sovereign models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for Arabic and English language use cases and KSA/GCC-specific regulatory environments (PDPL, Saudi data localization, cloud sovereignty requirements) Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from Saudi Arabia and the broader GCC Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and maintainable solutions for handoff Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues alongside customer teams What We're Looking For CS degree or equivalent experience 3+ years building and shipping production software — you've written code that real users depended on, you've been on-call for it, and you've debugged it when things broke. (A consulting background counts if this is also true of you.) Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.) Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You know what to monitor, what to alert on, and what "healthy" looks like High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count You've built APIs from scratch, not just consumed them — OpenAPI spec, REST/GraphQL design, auth, rate limiting, versioning, idempotency Event-driven thinking and cloud-native instincts Exposure to SIP, WebRTC, or real-time voice/messaging systems Self-sufficient by default — there's no engineering team behind you. You read the code and the docs, ask the customer (not your manager), and make sound engineering judgment calls on your own Customer-facing engineering experience — you can run discovery with a customer's engineers and present to their executives in the same week Ability to translate "it's not working" into root cause Comfortable working on customer sites and in high-stakes technical conversations Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Arabic. You can run whiteboard sessions, live troubleshooting, and escalations with customer engineering teams. Based in Riyadh, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across the Kingdom and broader GCC Legally authorized to work in Saudi Arabia, or eligible for sponsorship Bonus Points For Experience with AI voice assistants, STT/TTS, or LLM-based conversational systems Building eval sets for a specific domain Hands-on production experience with an LLM gateway — LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway, or an in-house OpenAI-compatible proxy — including config-driven model definitions, routing and fallback rules, and virtual key management Familiarity with the open-weight model landscape and the trade-offs

dbf254b90cc6f1ec.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الرحاب للعطور عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المتخصصة في مجال المبيعات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع الزبائن لتحديد مشكلاتهم ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية. تقييم أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الاتجاهات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع العملاء والزملاء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم الأداء وتحديد مجالات التحسين. القدرة على وضع الخطط البيعية وتحويل الأهداف إلى إجراءات عملية. مهارات تنظيمية عالية في إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي المبيعات في بيئة ديناميكية في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق مبيعات شركة الرحاب للعطور، ويكون مسؤولاً عن تحقيق الأهداف البيعية للشركة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة الرحاب للعطور، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

dbfa27288e824a00.description: About the Role Mayar Foods is seeking a Storekeeper to manage inventory, maintain store operations, and supervise activities within its facilities. This full-time position is based in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia and requires 0-1 years of experience. Role Overview The Storekeeper is responsible for overseeing all material movements to and from warehouses, ensuring efficient and safe handling to minimize damage. The role involves regular inspections and managing daily collections from sales representatives, contributing to the smooth operation of the supply chain. Key Responsibilities Prepare the store for incoming stock, adhering to standard operating procedures for space management. Supervise loaders and laborers, coordinating with logistics for the dispatch of customer orders. Ensure the hygiene of trucks and proper loading of goods, including visual inspection for potential issues like leakage, especially during monsoon seasons. Oversee the off-loading of stock, reviewing goods for damages or shortages, and reporting any issues to the Warehouse Manager or Logistics Supervisor. Receive damaged and returned goods, assess their condition, and obtain necessary approvals before acceptance. Identify and report unsafe conditions or work practices within the store environment. Ensure safe and timely loading and unloading operations, verifying goods against a checklist. Conduct periodic physical stock counts, complete counting sheets, reconcile variances in SKUs, and update records accordingly. Verify and maintain appropriate stock arrangement within the store. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a storekeeping or related role. Ability to manage inventory and supervise store activities effectively. Familiarity with material handling procedures and safety protocols. Work Type This is a full-time position within Mayar Foods, offering an opportunity to contribute to a key operational function. Location The role is based in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia.

dba2b3a7e1a539b6.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع السلامه الطبي عن أخصائي جودة للانضمام إلى فريقه في خميس مشيط، عسير. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم وتطبيق معايير الجودة، وتقييم رضا العملاء، وتطوير أنظمة تدقيق الجودة لضمان تقديم خدمات عالية المستوى. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل وإعداد وتصميم أدلة ونماذج إدارة الجودة، وتحديد وتطوير مواصفات ومعايير ومؤشرات لمختلف العمليات والمخرجات. المساهمة الفعالة في تطوير معايير ومواصفات الجودة المطلوبة للمبادرات والبرامج والمخرجات قيد التطوير وفقاً لخطط العمل. إعداد وتطوير استبيانات قياس مستوى رضا العملاء عن جودة الخدمات والعمليات والإجراءات، وتوثيق وتحليل توصياتهم التحسينية. تطوير أنظمة وإجراءات ونماذج تدقيق الجودة، والمشاركة في وضع خطط التدقيق الدوري والسنوي، وتنفيذ عمليات ضبط وتدقيق الجودة بشكل متكامل ودقيق. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالجودة، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الجودة أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تصميم وتطبيق أدلة ونماذج إدارة الجودة. فهم عميق لمعايير ومواصفات الجودة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم رضا العملاء وتطوير الأنظمة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مجمع السلامه الطبي بمدينة خميس مشيط، عسير. يتم العمل ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة في الخدمات المقدمة. التقديم لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.

dbb9aa2beb953136.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الامداد المتمكن المحدودة عن مسوق إلكتروني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التسويق الرقمي، ويقدم فرصة للعمل بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة ديناميكية. يركز الدور على تطوير وإدارة الحملات الإعلانية الرقمية من الفكرة الأولية وحتى تحقيق النتائج الملموسة، مع التركيز على تحويل الظهور الإعلاني إلى تفاعل حقيقي وفعال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إنشاء وإدارة الحملات الإعلانية عبر منصات التواصل الاجتماعي المختلفة. تطوير الاستراتيجيات والأفكار الإعلانية المبتكرة والمناسبة لكل حملة. متابعة أداء الحملات الإعلانية بشكل مستمر وتحليل النتائج لتحسينها. إعداد المحتوى الإعلاني وصياغة الأفكار والرسائل التسويقية الجذابة. تصميم محتوى مرئي جذاب ومناسب للحملات على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي. ابتكار أفكار إبداعية للمحتوى والإعلانات لزيادة التفاعل. متابعة أحدث التوجهات (الترندات) وتوظيفها لخدمة العلامة التجارية. العمل على تطوير الحضور الرقمي للشركة وزيادة التفاعل والوصول إلى الجمهور المستهدف. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في التسويق الإلكتروني وإدارة الحملات الإعلانية. القدرة على تحليل الأرقام وقراءة نتائج الحملات الإعلانية بفعالية. معرفة جيدة بتصميم محتوى وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي. الجمع بين الإبداع التسويقي والقدرة على التنفيذ العملي. الطموح والرغبة في المساهمة في نمو الشركة. المهارات الشخصية التفكير الإبداعي وتقديم أفكار غير تقليدية في التسويق. القدرة على تحويل الأفكار الإعلانية إلى نتائج حقيقية وملموسة. فهم عميق لكيفية تحويل الإعلان من مجرد ظهور إلى تفاعل فعال. بيئة العمل العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق يسعى لتحقيق نمو مستمر للشركة من خلال استراتيجيات تسويقية مبتكرة وفعالة. تفاصيل إضافية يتراوح الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي. إذا كنت ترى أن التسويق يتجاوز مجرد الإعلان ويشمل الفكرة المقنعة والتصميم الجذاب والحملة التي تحقق النتائج، فإننا ندعوك لتقديم إبداعك.

dbd18c6802089293.description: About the Role SME Careers is seeking a Malayalam Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) for a remote, contract position in Saudi Arabia. This role involves overseeing quality, consistency, and trainer performance across Malayalam AI training projects. The QAL will review AI-generated Malayalam content and work from trainers and QAs, ensuring adherence to project guidelines and quality standards. This position is crucial for improving AI models by ensuring Malayalam training data is accurate, culturally appropriate, and aligned with client expectations. Key Responsibilities Conduct spot-checks of Malayalam items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback, and escalate critical concerns. Communicate updates to trainers and QAs regarding new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, and quality expectations. Respond promptly and clearly to trainer/QA questions, particularly concerning Malayalam wording, register, translation fidelity, cultural context, and regional usage. Manage trainer/QA activation by contacting inactive contributors, encouraging participation, tracking follow-ups, and flagging availability issues. Create and maintain Malayalam project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, and onboarding materials. Schedule and conduct onboarding/training calls for trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, and Malayalam-specific style requirements. Ensure consistent application of Malayalam language guidelines by all trainers and QAs, and communicate project updates effectively. Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and contribute to building scalable QA processes for Malayalam-language projects. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Malayalam, Linguistics, Translation, Communications, Journalism, English, Education, Quality Assurance, or a related field. Native or near-native Malayalam proficiency with strong reading and writing skills. Strong grasp of the English language for following guidelines, team communication, and providing feedback. 3+ years of professional experience in Malayalam writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or similar language review workflows. Strong understanding of Malayalam grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, tone, register, regional variation, and cultural context. Ability to evaluate Malayalam content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, or inconsistent terminology. Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, editors, or QAs is preferred. Experience with AI training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, or rubric-based LLM QA is a strong advantage. Required Skills Excellent attention to detail and structured communication abilities. Proficiency in managing quality workflows across remote teams. Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, and project management systems. Highly organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, and other quality documentation. Work Environment This is an hourly, remote contractor role with SME Careers, a subsidiary of SuperAnnotate. The position involves working with remote teams to deliver training data for AI companies and foundation-model labs. Application Process The selection process for this role includes an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter.

db0c5ade7c41e0c9.description: About Accor Accor is a global hospitality group comprising over 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants, and various lifestyle destinations. The company focuses on creating positive and memorable impacts for guests, colleagues, and the planet through responsible hospitality practices. Accor offers opportunities for professional development and advancement within its network. The Role of Hostess Accor is seeking a professional and enthusiastic Hostess to join its hospitality team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role serves as the initial point of contact for guests, focusing on creating a welcoming atmosphere and ensuring smooth dining experiences. The position requires strong organizational skills, a commitment to guest service, and adherence to brand standards, contributing directly to the restaurant's operational success. Key Responsibilities Welcome and greet guests with professionalism, setting a positive tone for their dining experience. Manage guest seating, table allocations, and dining flow efficiently based on reservations and walk-ins. Maintain comprehensive knowledge of menus, special events, seating arrangements, and guest preferences. Coordinate with service and kitchen teams to ensure smooth operations and timely guest accommodations. Handle guest inquiries, feedback, and concerns with empathy, escalating issues when necessary. Manage reservation systems accurately, including guest details, seating plans, and preference notes. Confirm reservation information and communicate updates promptly to relevant team members. Answer phone calls professionally, assisting guests with inquiries, bookings, and special requests. Maintain an organized, clean, and inviting host stand and reception area throughout all service periods. Perform side duties such as menu preparation, table resets, and entrance area maintenance. Uphold all health, safety, hygiene, and company service standards consistently. Contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment through effective communication and mutual support. Remain calm, attentive, and organized during busy service periods while managing multiple priorities. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of experience in a relevant hospitality role. Demonstrated organizational skills and attention to detail. Commitment to delivering outstanding guest service. Ability to coordinate effectively with various teams. Capability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Work Environment The Hostess will work within a hospitality team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, contributing to a collaborative environment. The role involves interaction with guests and coordination with service and kitchen staff to ensure seamless operations. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion Accor is an inclusive company committed to attracting, recruiting, and promoting diverse talent.

dba8370b24cddb5e.description: About the Role NES Global Talent is seeking a Construction Manager - Package 1 for a full-time position. This role involves leading all construction-related activities, providing leadership to multidisciplinary teams, and ensuring contractors deliver work safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards on a world-class mega-project. Role Context This position offers the opportunity to work within a dynamic international environment alongside major industry stakeholders on a landmark petrochemical megaproject. It is suited for a seasoned construction professional who thrives in large-scale project environments and is focused on delivering complex industrial facilities safely, efficiently, and successfully. Key Responsibilities Lead, coordinate, and manage all construction activities across Package 1. Promote and strengthen a strong HSE culture, ensuring safety remains the top priority on site. Develop construction strategies, execution plans, and site management procedures. Drive schedule performance by identifying risks, delays, and optimization opportunities. Review and approve construction methodologies, work plans, construction sequences, and execution strategies. Oversee contractors' construction engineering, field planning, coordination, and execution activities. Ensure effective management of testing and pre-commissioning activities. Coordinate closely with engineering, commissioning, operations, and project management teams to ensure a smooth transition to operations. Manage site interfaces, change management processes, and construction-related contractual matters. Monitor project performance in terms of safety, quality, cost, and schedule. Facilitate constructability reviews, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure complete and accurate project documentation, including final handover and As-Built dossiers. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in construction management. Demonstrated experience in large-scale project environments and complex construction operations. Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage contractors effectively. Work Environment This role operates within a collaborative, multicultural project environment, offering exposure to large-scale EPC execution in one of the world's leading energy hubs. Application Information Salary for this position will be disclosed during the application process.

dbede3d9d4054e67.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فيصل سالم النعيمى عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت، والتحقيق في الحوادث، وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع المنشآت. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل لضمان الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتسجيل النتائج ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز باستخدام الأجهزة المتخصصة، وتوثيق النتائج، ومتابعة معالجة الأخطار مع الجهات المختصة. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيقات اللازمة، وتوثيق النتائج بشكل دقيق. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن، وتعليمات الإخلاء، وتوعية العاملين بها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها، وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على متابعة وتطبيق اللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والتوثيق. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصحة والسلامة المهنية ضمن فريق شركة فيصل سالم النعيمى في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل تلتزم بمعايير السلامة والجودة. الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب التواجد في مواقع العمل المختلفة حسب الحاجة. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة فيصل سالم النعيمى، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

dbc4bfa400a129ef.description: About Egis Egis is an international firm specializing in architecture, consulting, construction engineering, and mobility services. The company focuses on creating and operating intelligent infrastructures and buildings that address climate challenges and contribute to sustainable territorial development. Operating in 77 countries with 23,500 employees, Egis delivers expertise and innovative solutions globally. In the Middle East, Egis employs 3,500 professionals across 8 countries, having completed over 700 development projects. Recognized among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development and serves as a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers through its comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services. The Role of Environmental Specialist Egis is seeking an Environmental Specialist to join its team in Riyadh. This permanent contract position involves analyzing environmental aspects of infrastructure projects and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. The specialist will play a key role in preparing documentation for environmental permits and providing technical support to design teams. Key Responsibilities Analyze environmental aspects related to infrastructure projects under development. Participate in preparing documentation for environmental permits, approvals, and authorizations. Contribute to the development of project presentation reports, technical documentation for environmental permitting, specialized environmental studies, and environmental sections of technical design documentation. Identify potential environmental impacts and propose prevention, mitigation, or compensation measures. Assess technical solutions from an environmental protection perspective. Provide technical support to design teams regarding applicable environmental requirements. Conduct site visits and field surveys to collect information for environmental documentation. Cooperate with environmental experts, consultants, and competent authorities. Monitor compliance with conditions established by permits and regulatory documents. Prepare documentation for submission to relevant authorities. Participate in meetings and technical sessions with clients and permitting authorities. Respond to requests for clarifications and additional information from authorities. Follow up on the status of environmental permits and approvals. Monitor legislative changes in environmental protection. Inform management and project teams about applicable legal requirements and obligations. Propose compliance measures and internal process improvements. Prepare technical reports and activity updates for assigned projects. Ensure proper recording, filing, and archiving of environmental documentation. Provide information, data, and technical input to management and clients. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in environmental management or a related field. Demonstrated ability to analyze environmental aspects of infrastructure projects.
